note: Tricky real one: a four-person startup founder writing from Gmail. Free email counts, but only a little.
text:
Hi Riley,

I'm Noah, co-founder of Tidepool, a small startup building scheduling tools for clinics (we're four people right now). I saw your project on GitHub and wondered if you'd be interested in a paid part-time frontend internship this spring, around $25/hour. If you're open to it, I'd love to set up a video call next week so you can meet the team and ask questions.

Noah
noah.tidepool@gmail.com
